items.title: Every live site renders exactly one credit; getalloro.com renders none
items.precondition: Read-only export of the 18 LIVE, non-archived projects (wrapper, header, footer, home page sections) from production on 2026-10-28
steps: 1. Run renderPage() from this branch on each exported site
2. Count 'Powered by ... Alloro' matches, excluding the Alloro Protect form badge
items.expected: 17 sites show 1 credit; alloro.com (project acc7cbfc) shows 0; the 5 sites with a saved credit get no second one
items.evidence: 12 injected inside </footer>, 5 kept their saved credit, alloro.com 0. No page had 2.
items.notes: Home page only. operation-honor-rural-salute has a credit in content on another page; that page keeps it and gets no footer credit.

items.title: Credit is readable on the footer it lands in
items.precondition: Rendered HTML from T1, opened in a browser
steps: 2. Read the credit's text color and the nearest background color
items.expected: Text takes the footer's color, full-width block, logo loads
items.evidence: All 12: light text on dark footer, full width, logo loaded. Screenshot of robison-orthodontics taken locally.
items.notes: All current live footers are dark. A light footer is not yet live to check.

items.title: Credit shows on the deployed renderer
items.precondition: PR merged and renderer deployed; render cache expired or busted
steps: 3. Open alloro.com and check the footer
items.expected: Credit visible on both client sites; none on alloro.com
items.evidence: 2026-10-28, after deploy run 40588540468 (merge 5b33ec2) went green: all 18 live sites fetched on <host>.sites.getalloro.com. 17 show exactly 1 visible credit (12 newly added, 5 kept their saved one); bold-wellness-4474 (alloro.com) shows 0. Before/after diff of 5 pages: only robison-orthodontics changed (6 lines, the credit block). soliduscoatings.com custom domain shows the new credit.
items.notes: anewveteran.org custom domain still points to a Wix site, so visitors there do not see the Alloro site or the credit. Light-footer case still untested: no live site has one.
